scope: Visible anatomy and camera/hand continuity only across six source poses, assessed directly from source-derived private views against the new standing canonical. No actor approval, animation implementation approval, generation, or asset/index/Git mutation.
verdict_basis: The lower-right pointed boot direction is compatible with legs trailing a flying NW-facing body and ankles held extended/plantarflexed. Direction on the canvas alone does not demonstrate a 180-degree boot reversal. Across all six poses, the visible paired hip exits, knees, shins, ankle rims and boots form coherent continuous chains without an evident knee/ankle contradiction.
limits: Hip sockets and parts of upper thighs are occluded by armor/cape. This is uncertainty about hidden geometry, not an observed disconnection.
Gold armor flares can obscure precise joint centers and heel/toe boundaries. The report assesses visible continuity and a plausible pose, not a uniquely determined hidden skeleton.
The source is visually a flying/trailing-leg pose sequence; this reassessment does not assert grounded walking foot mechanics.
comparison_to_standing: Standing-reference near boot projects more to image left with a flexed ankle; source boots extend down-right relative to their shins. The change can arise from an extended trailing ankle and a different airborne leg pose without rotating the dorsal torso or pelvis toward NE. Helmet/back/pelvis and weapon/empty-hand sides remain consistent with the standing NW view.
